title: Cosmic Turtle Scholar
description: A green anthropomorphic turtle with a large afro made of glowing mathematical symbols sits in the foreground reading an open book titled 'Let No Man Know'. Behind it stretches a surreal landscape with floating books, ink puddles, and a massive black hole eclipse dominating the purple and orange sky.
prompt: A wise green anthropomorphic turtle with golden eyes and a large curly afro composed of floating mathematical symbols and letters sits smiling while reading an ancient book titled Let No Man Know. The turtle's shell has text on it. Surreal landscape with melting books, ink puddles, floating geometric shapes, and a giant black hole solar eclipse in a dramatic purple and orange sky. Fantasy painting style with dripping paint effects at the bottom.
